method: Cryptographic package tarball audit, npm registry metadata inspection, lifecycle scripts analysis, license and distribution obligations evaluation (MPL-2.0, MIT, BSD-3-Clause), patent pool licensing review (MPEG-LA AVC, Via LA AAC), browser WebCodecs capability verification, and non-shipping gate validation. Zero unreviewed code installed or shipped before review approval.

artifacts.name: mediabunny

legal_analysis.copyleft_scope: File-level weak copyleft (Section 3.1). Any direct modifications to Mediabunny source files must remain licensed under MPL-2.0 and made available upon distribution.
legal_analysis.larger_work_provision: Section 3.3 explicitly permits combining Mediabunny with independent software modules to form a Larger Work without subjecting the other modules to MPL-2.0, provided Mediabunny source files remain separate.
legal_analysis.distribution_obligations: Section 3.2 governs distribution of Executable Form (client-side bundled/minified JS). Recipients must be informed of how they can obtain the Source Code of Mediabunny (e.g. by providing a link to https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny or public archive), and copyright/NOTICE statements must be preserved.
legal_analysis.patent_grant: Section 5 provides an express patent license from each contributor covering patent claims inevitably infringed by the covered code.

findings: Pure TypeScript implementation providing high-performance media container parsing, demuxing, muxing, WebCodecs integration, and fragmented MP4 generation.
Completely self-contained runtime: zero runtime npm dependencies, zero network requests, no postinstall scripts.
Safe integration pattern requires keeping Mediabunny as an un-modified external dependency package rather than copying/vendoring its source into proprietary modules.
artifacts.usage_policy: Approved for evaluation in P8-02 browser export spike as an unmodified external package dependency. Bundle notices must include MPL-2.0 attribution and public source code repository link.

artifacts.name: @webav/av-cliper

legal_analysis.distribution_obligations: Copyright notice and MIT permission notice must be retained in client bundle distributions.
legal_analysis.package_json_issue: Sub-package package.json published on npm omits explicit 'license' field; root repo WebAV-Tech/WebAV defines standard MIT license (1059 bytes).
legal_analysis.commercial_pro_distinction: Author maintains closed-source 'WebAV Pro' features (commercial timeline UI, advanced visual transitions) under proprietary terms. Only open-source core @webav/av-cliper is evaluated.
legal_analysis.patent_grant: Standard MIT; no express patent grant clause.

findings: WebCodecs-based timeline synthesis combining video, audio, image, and canvas layers directly in browser context.
Zero lifecycle install scripts; reproducible local build without network postinstall fetches.
Relies on @webav/mp4box.js (BSD-3-Clause) for ISO BMFF packaging, opfs-tools for Origin Private File System staging, and wave-resampler for audio rate conversion.
Upstream demo clips (Big Buck Bunny, Tears of Steel) lack commercial rights clearance and Vietnamese typography; strictly blocked under P0-03 rights policy.
artifacts.usage_policy: Approved for P8-02 browser export spike evaluation with explicit MIT attribution. Pro proprietary extensions and unreviewed demo assets strictly blocked.

artifacts.name: @webav/av-canvas
findings: Combines Text, Image, Video, and Audio into MediaStream in browser DOM/Canvas environment.
Requires active DOM or OffscreenCanvas context.
artifacts.usage_policy: Allowed for DOM/Canvas frame synthesis in P8-02 spike under strict MIT notice preservation.

artifacts.name: @webav/av-recorder
findings: Encodes MediaStream to MP4 using WebCodecs API and mp4box.js muxer.
artifacts.usage_policy: Alternative stream recorder candidate for browser export evaluation.

artifacts.name: @webav/internal-utils
findings: Shared internal utilities for WebAV packages with disclaimer warning against direct external usage.
artifacts.usage_policy: Transitive dependency only; do not import directly.

artifacts.name: @webav/mp4box.js
findings: JavaScript port of GPAC MP4Box for ISO BMFF stream parsing, demuxing, and fragmented packaging.
artifacts.usage_policy: Transitive dependency; retain BSD-3-Clause notices in client bundle.

artifacts.name: opfs-tools
findings: Provides high-performance disk-backed chunk streaming via OPFS in Web Workers.
artifacts.usage_policy: Allowed for large-frame buffering in browser Web Workers.

artifacts.name: wave-resampler
findings: Pure JS linear/sinc audio resampling utility for 48kHz normalization.
artifacts.usage_policy: Allowed for audio sample rate normalization before WebCodecs AudioEncoder.

h264_avc.patent_pool: MPEG-LA / Via LA AVC Patent Portfolio
h264_avc.browser_native_webcodecs: ALLOWED_NO_ROYALTY_FOR_WEBAPP: WebCodecs VideoEncoder invokes host platform hardware/OS encoder (Apple VideoToolbox, Microsoft Media Foundation, Android MediaCodec). Platform vendors hold hardware/OS licenses; web app distributes no codec binaries and incurs no direct patent royalties.
h264_avc.client_software_wasm: STRICTLY_BLOCKED: Bundling software H.264 encoders (such as GPL libx264 compiled to WASM) into client web application is strictly prohibited due to GPL viral copyleft, Creativanta commercial boundary violation, and unindemnified MPEG-LA royalty exposure.

aac_audio.browser_native_webcodecs: ALLOWED_NO_ROYALTY_FOR_WEBAPP: Native WebCodecs AudioEncoder with mp4a.40.2 (AAC-LC) is covered by host platform licensing. Server fallback applied when browser lacks native AAC encoder.
aac_audio.client_software_wasm: STRICTLY_BLOCKED: No software AAC encoders with non-free or patent-encumbered licenses.

vp9_av1_opus.status: ALLOWED_ROYALTY_FREE: Fully permitted for WebM packaging and MP4 AV1 streams.

non_shipping_gate.enforcement: assertBrowserExportGateApproved() throws BrowserExportGatePendingError on any attempt to execute browser rendering pipeline before formal reviewer sign-off.
